title: abrahamaiproject-bit/driver-mobile-app
body:
# driver-mobile-app

React Native app that Lumen Freight drivers use to view their stop list, navigate, and capture proof of delivery.

## v2 features (in progress)
- Swipe-to-complete stop list
- Offline mode
- Proof-of-delivery photo capture

## Development
```bash
npm install
npx expo start
```
